evidence_chain: method principle explains why the auxiliary coefficient exists
loss definition and reduction establish the mathematical scale
Train-only loss and backbone-gradient audit checks whether the registered grid spans meaningful influence
a frozen Simulation Validation protocol selects the final value without Test or real-XRD access
multi-seed sensitivity evidence checks that the final result is not a lucky isolated point

lambda_js.necessity_basis: balances paired-view JS consistency against supervised classification
lambda_js.mathematical_scale: natural-log JS divergence is batch mean and lies in [0, ln(2)]
lambda_js.current_grid_basis: legacy internal preregistration only; not independent numerical authority
lambda_js.train_only_scale_result: all registered values have negligible median backbone-gradient influence under the frozen audit
lambda_js.final_selection: three-point Simulation Validation search after the candidate range is frozen

lambda_res.necessity_basis: balances residual class-confusion KL against supervised classification
lambda_res.mathematical_scale: KL(q || Uniform) equals ln(7)-H(q), uses batch mean, and lies in [0, ln(7)]
lambda_res.current_grid_basis: legacy internal YAML/default only; not independent numerical authority
lambda_res.train_only_scale_result: all registered values have negligible median backbone-gradient influence under the frozen audit
lambda_res.final_selection: three-point Simulation Validation search after the candidate range is frozen

warmup_epochs.basis: prevent the residual objective from influencing the initial classifier trajectory
warmup_epochs.selection_policy: fixed; exact schedule is unit-tested; no result-driven search

ramp_epochs.basis: smoothly introduce the residual objective after warm-up
ramp_epochs.selection_policy: fixed; exact schedule is unit-tested; no result-driven search

diagnostic_scale_centers.interpretation: Train-only median coefficient for unit auxiliary backbone-gradient norm to match classification; diagnostic only, not a selected or automatically registered value

one_revision_policy.required_before_revision: review whether the audit trajectory and influence bands are sufficiently representative before choosing a single overall logarithmic shift
one_revision_policy.required_after_revision: update this file, the main contract, hashes, documentation, and rerun both audits before freezing
